publicLiveFare684A.reason: Three exact leg searches plus at most one same-city metro fallback search per leg.

affordableDiscovery684B.reason: Each of two candidates may invoke one complete 684A verification with up to six Duffel searches.

aggregateRequestRisk.calculation: Up to 6 searches for the initially selected flight route plus up to 12 searches across two rescue candidates.
aggregateRequestRisk.risk: Expanding origin eligibility increases the share of user requests that can consume Duffel quota. Per-invocation bounded concurrency does not coordinate simultaneous Lambda invocations.

recommended703B.name: Five-Origin Final-Schedule Live Verification
recommended703B.reason: These five origins already exist in 684A's code-level default. Expanding only final-selected-schedule verification isolates origin coverage from 684B's higher provider-call amplification.

recommended703CPrerequisite.name: Request-Scoped Aggregate Duffel Budget
recommended703CPrerequisite.goal: Share one provider-search budget across 684B candidate discovery, final 684A verification and over-budget rescue within a generated-tour request.
recommended703CPrerequisite.note: The final ceiling should be validated with live latency/quota telemetry before production promotion.

notRecommendedYet: Unlock 684B discovery to 10-25 origins without an aggregate request budget
Expand to children or multiple adults in the same release as origin expansion
Treat Duffel search offers as booking-guaranteed prices
Add order/payment/ticketing capability as part of 703A or 703B
